title: So much potential but free version is so limited
body: The app is really professional and well done but can barely be used unless u pay, for broke users like me, it’s kind of useless unless u pay. Would rather just see some ads here and there rather than pay for it. Take note, potential downloaders: you can literally only set 3 habits
author: georgiacreate123

title: Good app but slightly outdated
body:
I get this app to help me build a few lasting habits and it succeeded in doing just that. 

The only downside is that it doesn't work all that well in iOS 13. The problems I'm encountering are the inability to add a check-in, change habit or even stability. There were instances when the app would freeze.

I sure hope the devs will update the app so it could help many other users looking to pick a good habit.
author: zidar

title: Good for ‘in Phone’.
body: But terrible for Apple Watch especially after the WatchOS update. App keeps crashing. Reported & emailed to company but they are taking way too long to fix the crash issue even when they responded with ‘soon’. A simple app to track habits crashes but another complex app that does more does not even hv problems.
author: Saiizan

title: Good overall but hope to have better photo features
body: I love the options of including photos to track my habits. It can be better if we could edit the photos’ date or jot some notes on the photos, as well as viewing it in grid options and not just in slides.
author: Polarajqb162

title: Good but better if one click can add data to Apple health
body: Good app. But can you turn the one click tracking to input data into Apple health kit? Rather than typing. It would be perfect if it can
author: Zhiminglam

title: Best and most customizable habit tracker I’ve used!
body: I love how you can pretty much create custom dashboards for each habit you’re tracking that makes it really easy to visualize how you’re progressing on a particular habit! Amazing app and looking forward to more from the developers!
author: Kevincjz

title: The app is beautiful
body: and simple enough to meet my needs

title: Neat app with good design
body: I seriously think this app have potential to be better. I'm gonna pay for premium and let's hope the dev can fulfil the promise of integration on watch as well. It's quite nice to see that this habit tracker is easier to use with this app unlike other competition.
